edition: Version of record, Flow, Turbulence and Combustion 115, 1157–1180 (2025). The PDF header labels this a Review, but §3.2.2 and Tables 4–5 contain original matched simulations.
source_location: §3.2.2, Table 4 p. 1173 (actual run membership), Table 5 p. 1174 (outcomes), and Fig. 6 p. 1174 (distinct reference); archived author copy Tables 4–5 pp. 17–18 checked against final values.
reference: Table 5 labels Expe., with (xsep/h,xreatt/h)=(0.19,4.21). Figure 6 instead labels black reference wrLES generated in Argo-DG and used in training. Use the table-labelled experiment for the numerical analysis.
physical_condition: Periodic hills at Re_b=10595, M=.1, pressure gradient maintains bulk Re, common restart from a coarse wall-resolved LES and same nondimensional time step .005. All three comparison runs at p4, 28,788,750 degrees of freedom. The paper trained on this very flow; these are coupled training-condition comparisons, not a held-out geometry or Reynolds number.
criterion: For each crossing use absolute |x_model/h−x_Expe/h|. Change is second run minus first run. A negative number means a closer nominal location. Report the separation and reattachment outputs separately.

Rcht-A-512-p4.model: Analytical wall-stress model using Reichardt profile

DD-A-512-p4.model: CNN-skip-GMH. Sample the two stress components, compute magnitude, then impose alignment with the sampled velocity

comparisons.controls: Both align, hwm/h=.1 and p4 with same nominal DOF. WSS model changes analytical→learned stochastic magnitude. Accumulation increases ~15→~19 flow-throughs.
Same trained component model, p4 and nominal DOF. Remove alignment, move hwm/h from .1 to .08, adjust first cell size with the new height, and extend accumulation from ~19 to ~25 flow-throughs.
Model, alignment, sampling height/first-cell size, and accumulation (~15→~25 flow-throughs) all change; p4 and nominal DOF shared.

excluded_row: DD-NA-512-p3 is p3, hwm/h=.1 with 25,473,600 DOF and ~36 flow-throughs; different mesh/degree from p4 although both learned runs use a CNN. Table 5 (.217,3.690) is not used to claim a clean p4 effect.
uncertainty: Table 5 prints simulated crossings to .001h and the experimental values to .01h. Sampling periods are unequal and only approximate, and joint experimental/simulation uncertainty is not given. Ranks are point-estimate comparisons.
